Could we schedule a 30-minute call with one of our healthcare customers who matches that profile? I can pull a short list and coordinate availability. If Polaris prefers, we can limit details to non-PHI operational practices and let the advocate confirm high-level metrics.

Proposed slots next week (ET): Tue 3/28 10:00–10:30, Tue 3/28 14:00–14:30, Wed 3/29 11:00–11:30. I’ll arrange an NDA if needed — we can use the Polaris NDA you mentioned.

HealSync is available and comfortable speaking at a high level. They can confirm VPC deployment, private control plane, and our approach to KV-caching that reduced token costs in production.
